description: Source code for a sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing RTIO device interface with configuration, data handling, and timer-based execution.

methods.name: vnd_sensor_iodev_read
methods.description: Reads sensor data into buffer, managing sample number and buffer size.

methods.name: vnd_sensor_iodev_execute
methods.description: Executes I/O operation based on the queued request, handling RX operation.

methods.name: vnd_sensor_iodev_submit
methods.description: Submits I/O request to the internal queue.

methods.name: vnd_sensor_handle_int
methods.description: Handles timer interrupt, triggers sensor data processing.

methods.name: vnd_sensor_timer_expiry
methods.description: Timer callback that triggers sensor data handling.

methods.name: vnd_sensor_init
methods.description: Initializes sensor device, configures timer and internal state.
